messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur10e-manual, p. 162

11. The First Program Add additional 1. In your Robot Program, select a Move node or Waypoint node. waypoints to a 2. Under Basic, tap Waypoint. The additional waypoint is added under the waypoint that you selected in the robot program. Detail Using a waypoint means applying the taught relationship between the feature and the TCP from the Move command. The relationship between the feature and the TCP, applied to the current selected feature, achieves the desired TCP location. The robot calculates how to position the arm to allow the current active TCP to reach the desired TCP position. 11.9. Using the Move Tab UR10e 165 User Manual
